Region 264.0 has 15 prior purchases on this card before the alert.
Device Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080 is also linked to 3 other card(s): C02354-K2, C07987-K2, C09933-K2.
Email domain gmail.com is present on the flagged purchase; email_fanout found 26 other cards, treated as too common for R6.
Billing region 264.0 appears on 17 other cards in the local 1-hop fan-out. Region sharing is recorded, not treated as proof of a shared origin.

Customer denied the purchase and still has the card.

case.summary: The investigation of case HHG-006 focused on a flagged online purchase of 482.12 USD on card C07297-K1 in billing region 264.0, supported by graph evidence showing 15 prior purchases in that region and a reconstructed episode of 5 related transactions totaling 1989.04 USD. The pattern identified was card_not_present_fraud with a fraud probability of 0.46. The applicable policy involves blocking the card, creating a case, and filing a report due to customer denial of the transaction.

sar.narrative: On 2016-11-21, card C07297-K1 belonging to customer C07297 was used for a 482.12 USD online transaction 3476682 in billing region 264.0. Episode reconstruction identified 5 related transactions totaling 1989.04 USD from 2016-11-21 to 2016-11-22. Graph analysis showed 15 prior purchases in the same region and linked the device used to three other cards (C02354-K2, C07987-K2, C09933-K2). The customer denied the transaction, and the investigation treated the purchase as unauthorized. The flagged card was recommended for blocking and reissue, and a report was filed for regulatory review.
